title: The thumb
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. The thumb, drawn enormous on Monday, becomes the week's subject: four panels of thumbs on four phones at four tables at Gully's, each scrolling something, one of them him.

panels.composition: A thumb on a phone. Scrolling. A tourist's, at Gully's window table.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a thumb scrolling a phone screen at a café table

panels.composition: A second thumb. A second phone. A local's, at the counter. Scrolling a boat listing.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a different thumb scrolling a boat listing on a phone at a counter

panels.composition: A third. A kid's. Scrolling fast — the strip, sliced, flying past in a blur, a Sunday's tiers as vertical smears.
props: a third phone: the strip, sliced

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a child's thumb scrolling fast past vertical smears of watercolor comic tiers on a phone
image.notes: Wood's Sundays going by as smears.

panels.composition: WOOD on the end stool. No phone. Drawing the three thumbs. GULLY looking at the drawing. BARNABY II. The one table without a screen.

balloons.text: Four. One's mine. It's holding a pen.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man drawing three thumbs on a pad while a stocky man looks over, a small three-legged dog beneath, the only table in the shop without a phone

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Four thumbs. 'One's mine. It's holding a pen.'
